method: Claims V01-V39 were built from v2-candidate-sources.json (one claim per source-code pair) by the orchestrating session and split across four independent codebook-citation-verifier agents. Claims U01-U09 are candidates found by a separate proposer agent (U01-U07: sources for the unsourced codes Y8.4, F1.7, A1.3) or replacement leads (U08, U09) raised in verifier notes, and were checked by a fifth, fresh verifier. Verifiers saw only the claim fields and the code's construct, never the proposer's reasoning. Verdicts are recorded as returned; three over-length excerpts (V31, V36, V37) were trimmed by the orchestrator to a verbatim sub-span of 40 words or fewer, with the verifier's original text kept in excerpt_as_returned.
